reason: Revision E-20260928-13-r2 answers REV-20260928-23: it adds a matched-information arm (the agent sees exactly the predicates' graph read-set) and a generic graph lint, fixes separate denominators (60 expressible, 40 prose-only violations, 140 benign), bounds C's false blocks, adds interval-based inconclusive branches, and moves to a public-data seeded fixture under POLICY-v1 caps; the unfetchable Palantir detail is marked unverified and made non-load-bearing. It tests whether the product can enforce B25 (firm) at action time and decides the ontology's Action types for priority 3.
